title: Tail mark at architectural scale
slide_intent: Evaluate the mark on a three-dimensional surface because distance, angle and reflected light affect recognition.
strategic_value: A large white crane on a dark tail can identify Lufthansa without relying on readable fuselage text.
demonstration: A close low-angle photograph places the dark tail and white crane above the wing against clouds.
practical_value: Check how symbol placement reads across the actual shape and viewing angles of an aircraft tail.

content_islands.name: Tail and symbol
content_islands.spec: Let the dark fin dominate the upper right.

content_islands.name: Aircraft and sky
content_islands.spec: Keep the pale wing in the foreground and cloud field behind.
